goal: Avoid copying byte buffers when duplicating or reordering script interpreter stack items
Prevent memory and CPU inflation if future soft forks expand stack element sizes past 520 bytes
agreement: Concept NACK due to heap allocation and refcounting overhead on the interpreter hot path (Yudis-bit)
Objection that sharing static elements introduces cross-core atomic contention in check queues (Yudis-bit)
Suggests chunking signatures across existing 520-byte elements instead of raising limits (ismaelsadeeq)
Unanswered question on overall stack byte limits if stack element sizes are increased (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: validation
why: P4 because it protects against a denial of service attack that is invalid under current consensus rules
Memory inflation from duplicated stack items only becomes a concern if element size limits are raised
